```yaml
guideline:
  channel: Backhouse Explainers
  genre: explainer
locked:
  caption_max_words: 3
  caption_size: 0.04
  music: off
runtime_s:
  min: 20
  max: 45
checks:
  banned_openings: ["Did you know", "In this video"]
  title_max_chars: 60
```

### G-topic: One concrete subject
stage: topic
Pick a single named thing, person or event. No listicles.

### G-hook: Open on the surprise
stage: script
The first sentence states the most surprising fact. No greetings.

### G-title: Plain and specific
stage: title
Titles name the subject and the surprise in under 60 characters.

### G-cover: One focal point
stage: cover
The cover shows one subject with at most four words of text.
